package.title: Auth session UX: duplicate-cookie CSRF tolerance, login/signup flight state, typed-value preservation

specification.intent: Close three operator-reported live defects of 2026-11-07. (1) Logout/refresh die with 403 csrf_failed when the request carries a duplicate chatty_csrf cookie: Starlette's Request.cookies parses only the FIRST raw Cookie header (headers.get('cookie')) and within a single header the LAST duplicate name wins (dict assignment) — either arrangement can shadow the fresh copy that document.cookie shows (live curl repro: two Cookie header entries, stale path-scoped copy first, correct X-CSRF-Token → 403). (2) A successful login shows the idle auth form through the whole signin+fetchUser flight before the router flip — operator asks for a loading state. (3) A failed login/registration wipes the typed credentials: the authError store update re-renders the page, registerComponent rebuilds Form/LabeledInput/Input from scratch, and input values lived only in the DOM — operator asks to keep values and show the error. The same-day already-committed work (auth error text mapping 1e3a1f4, overlay flake fix 3c9bb7f, gitignore 31d5304, progress log dff4674) and the operator-side CORS allowlist repair in .env.compose.local are context this plan rides on, not scope.

requirements.title: require_csrf matches the submitted header against ANY copy of the csrf cookie across all Cookie headers
requirements.description: backend/app/core/deps.py: replace the single-value request.cookies.get read (headers.get('cookie') — only the FIRST raw Cookie header, LAST duplicate within it) with a raw-Cookie-header scan (request.headers.getlist('cookie') split on ';', collect every value whose name equals settings.csrf_cookie_name) and accept when the submitted header constant-time-matches (hmac.compare_digest) ANY collected copy; missing header, no cookie at all, or a header matching no copy still raise 403 csrf_failed; validate_origin call and everything outside require_csrf untouched. New backend/tests/unit/auth/test_csrf_duplicates.py drives require_csrf directly on hand-built Starlette Request scopes: single-match passes; RED-GREEN PIN — a scope whose headers list carries TWO cookie entries (b'cookie', b'chatty_csrf=<stale>') and (b'cookie', b'chatty_csrf=<fresh>') passes with the fresh header value post-fix and FAILS on the unpatched require_csrf (the live logout repro shape; a same-header variant 'chatty_csrf=<fresh>; chatty_csrf=<stale>' — Starlette keeps the LAST duplicate — is pinned as a second red-green case); header matching no copy 403; missing header / no cookie 403. A prepared patch (deps.py fix AND the test file — inspect with git stash show --include-untracked 'stash@{0}') exists in git stash ("wip: csrf duplicate-cookie fix + tests") and MAY be applied as the implementation. Gate: backend pytest summary delta vs the captured baseline — the failed set is EXACTLY the 4 known pre-existing Windows ingestion/converter failures (tests/unit/ingestion/test_converter.py, WinError 193, predating this plan) and all new tests pass; backend/verify.sh exit code is non-zero at baseline on this Windows stand BY DESIGN, the verdict is the delta contract, not exit-0.
requirements.source: live operator report 2026-11-07 + curl repro (duplicate Cookie header → 403 csrf_failed with matching header)

requirements.title: Visible, safe auth flight state: disabled in-flight submit button + Enter-submit guard
requirements.description: src/utils/Store.ts: AppState and ComponentProps gain the optional field authLoading (boolean | undefined; field only, no mechanics, no new events). src/features/auth/store.ts: setAuthLoading(value) mirroring setAuthError. src/features/auth/controller.ts: signin and signup set authLoading=true before the first await and authLoading=false in a finally (success and every error path). src/features/auth/pages/login/login.ts and register/register.ts: withStore maps authLoading alongside authError; render() rewrites the primary submit button props while in flight — label 'Signing in…' (login) / 'Signing up…' (register), disabled true — reverting on settle; the page's handleSubmitClick ignores a submit while this.props.authLoading is true (Form's submit handler invokes handleSubmitClick on ANY submit event — a dispatched/implicit submit bypasses the disabled button entirely; browser implicit-submission behavior around disabled default buttons is historically inconsistent, so the page-level guard is the reliable barrier). src/components/button/button.ts: ButtonProps gains disabled?: boolean; button.hbs renders {{#if disabled}}disabled{{/if}}; form.hbs forwards disabled=this.disabled into the Button helper invocation (the buttons array reaches Button ONLY through the four-key hash in form.hbs — without this forwarding the attribute never renders); existing classType 'disabled' styling semantics untouched. src/features/auth/controller.test.ts: deferred-promise pins — authLoading true while the signin promise is pending, false after resolve AND after reject (signup mirrored).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-07 (successful login shows the auth form through the flight)

requirements.title: Typed login/register values survive error and loading re-renders
requirements.description: Pages own a private draft: Record<string, string> (empty initially). componentDidUpdate (login.ts, register.ts) harvests the live values from the OLD DOM before the re-render — this.element.querySelectorAll('input[name]') — into draft, then returns true; render() merges draft into the inputs array entries ({...input, value: draft[input.name] ?? ''}). Additive plumbing down the chain: FormInputs (src/components/form/form.ts) gains value?: string; form.hbs passes value=this.value into LabeledInput; labeledInput.hbs passes value=this.value into Input; input.hbs renders the value attribute CONDITIONALLY ({{#if value}}value="{{value}}"{{/if}} — no empty value="" attribute on inputs that carry no value; harmless either way since Input.setValue writes the DOM property which overrides the attribute, but the conditional keeps the profile forms' markup unchanged). The profile page and Form._setProfile behavior untouched. Tests: login.test.ts — fill login+password, store.set('authError', …) → after the re-render both inputs hold the typed values AND the error paragraph shows; register.test.ts — same pin for email/password/confirm_password; both also pin values surviving the authLoading toggle render.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-07 (failed login wipes typed credentials)

specification.goal: The operator can log out regardless of duplicate csrf cookies in browser history; login/registration show an honest in-flight state (disabled relabeled button, Enter-guarded) and never wipe what the user typed when the server answers with an error.
constraints: require_csrf keeps validate_origin first and the 403 csrf_failed detail shape; per-copy comparison stays hmac.compare_digest; no cookie contract change (set_auth_cookies byte-identical), no new envs, no migration.
Store.ts gains ONLY the optional authLoading field on AppState/ComponentProps — no mechanics, no events, no API change.
No busyOverlay for the form loader (form-local button state); auth transition targets after success unchanged.
Value plumbing is additive end to end (FormInputs.value?, hbs value pass-through); the profile page and its _setProfile flow untouched.
No comments in new/edited scss (none expected); imports with .ts extension; eslint:fix/stylelint:fix before commit; pre-commit verify hook is strict.
Conventional commits without co-author trailers; plan package committed; work/ artifacts never committed.
Existing suites stay green; no test deleted; the 4 Windows converter failures are pre-existing and out of scope.
nonGoals: no client-side logout fallback that ignores CSRF failures (server-side duplicate tolerance fixes the real cause)
no logout-all or profile UI changes
no router/transition change after successful auth
no i18n framework (inline in-flight labels like the existing form copy)
no fixes to the 4 pre-existing Windows converter test failures
specification.scope: backend duplicate-cookie CSRF tolerance + its unit tests (backend/app/core/deps.py, backend/tests/unit/auth/test_csrf_duplicates.py); frontend auth flight state + typed-value preservation with tests (src/utils/Store.ts field, src/features/auth store/controller/pages+tests, src/components form/input/button plumbing) + progress log; evidence under work/2026-11-07-auth-session-ux/.

criteria.title: Duplicate-cookie tolerance proven by pytest

Backend gate verdict: pytest summary delta vs the captured baseline — the failed set is exactly the 4 known pre-existing converter failures, all new tests passing (verify.sh exit code is non-zero at baseline on this Windows stand by design).

securityGates.statement: Duplicate tolerance compares the header ONLY against copies of the csrf cookie the site itself issued (same cookie name in the request's Cookie headers); per-copy comparison stays hmac.compare_digest; validate_origin still runs first; a header matching no copy still fails — no relaxation of the double-submit invariant (an attacker still cannot forge the X-CSRF-Token header cross-site).

No change to tokens, cookies, refresh rotation or the transport policy; Store.ts gains only the optional authLoading field; features/auth/transportPolicy.ts and utils/HTTPTransport.ts are forbidden writes.
